title: ConnectorJob
description: dispatch -> connector. A unit of work containing enough identity for the connector to clone the repository locally and create a sandbox. It never contains source code, diffs, or file contents.

clone_url.description: Uses the customer's own repository access; not a credentialed URL from Raphael.

narrowed_location.description: A private-core failure-detection result that tells the sandbox where to look, not what to do about it.

sandbox_profile.description: Name of a locally resolved sandbox profile. The profile contents never leave the customer environment.

lease_ttl_seconds.description: How long the connector may hold this job before dispatch considers it abandoned and reassigns or escalates it.
